name: Voyager — MySQL → YugabyteDB migration
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq default-mysql-client && sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true && sudo install -m 755 .devcontainer/scripts/yb-voyager-wrapper.sh /usr/local/bin/yb-voyager && docker-compose -f init-voyager-mysql/compose.yml pull && docker pull --platform linux/amd64 yugabytedb/yb-voyager:latest && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lerocha/chinook-database/master/ChinookDatabase/DataSources/Chinook_MySql.sql -o init-voyager-mysql/chinook_data.sql && mkdir -p /workspaces/ybdb-vanguard/init-voyager-mysql/voyager-data && echo "✅ MySQL Voyager exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-ybdb.sh 1 && sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true && docker-compose -f init-voyager-mysql/compose.yml up -d && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → mysql        (MySQL source shell)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → yb-voyager   (Voyager migration shell)"'

tasks.label: mysql-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual MySQL migration commands — yb-voyager, ysqlsh (init-voyager-mysql)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-mysql && echo '🐬 mysql-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual yb-voyager commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: mysql
tasks.detail: Open a MySQL client session against the source database (init-voyager-mysql)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for MySQL on :3306...'; until docker-compose -f init-voyager-mysql/compose.yml exec -T mysql mysql -h127.0.0.1 -uroot -p${env:SRC_SECRET} -e 'SELECT 1' >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 3; done; docker-compose -f init-voyager-mysql/compose.yml exec mysql mysql -uroot -p${env:SRC_SECRET}

tasks.label: mysql-demo
tasks.detail: "The MySQL Migration" — assess, export, import, finalise (init-voyager-mysql/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-voyager-mysql && echo '🐬 mysql-demo  —  MySQL → YugabyteDB migration' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash
